requests.play: reorganise business intents (#1021), BI-2 capability 2 draft, round 2
requests.question: Where is the design system a slice's screens follow set today?
requests.answer: Nowhere for the whole project. The stale screens lens reads its name from the product profile or an earlier product decision, says when none exists, and records the visual core as a decision later slices reuse, so as built the first slice sets it. The UX lens schema says the visual core is set once for the product. The drafts declare the design system as a guideline of the browser surface here, leave its technology to Design the technology and architecture, and its use in each slice to the lens.
